draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.98, the 141st-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 10th of 19 at DT. He went 75th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (141st): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (91st percentile), broad jump (98th percentile). College production: 4 sacks in 2020, 7th of 19 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the San Francisco 49ers. 84 career games and 76 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: qb hits 23 (99th percentile), pressures 31 (99th percentile), season snap share 62.5% (86th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 interior lineman who played: 31 pressures against a median of 6, above the norm.
